provenance_note: The reference corpus was authored independently without access to the tool code; this run recomputes every check from the shipping build through the same analyze() the interface uses.
reference: Hand-built LOTO schemes (single/multiple electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, pressure, chemical sources; capacitor, accumulator, receiver, raised-load, spring, rotating-mass and hot-mass stores; back-feed; shared isolation; energy conversion in equipment; control devices and non-return valves; incomplete lock/tag/role/verification; insufficient-data and malformed inputs) plus 12 seeded random electrical graphs. Route counts are recomputed by an own depth-first enumeration of simple directed paths (ref.py); categorical expectations follow 29 CFR 1910.147, HSE HSG253 and the EN 50110-1 five safety rules, or the spec's acceptance criteria.
reference_citations: HSE HSG253 'The safe isolation of plant and equipment', 2nd edition 2006, https://www.hse.gov.uk/pubns/priced/hsg253.pdf — paras 151, 155, 156, 173

EN 50110-1 five safety rules (standard not read; wording as reproduced in Siemens SINAMICS CONNECT 500 operating instructions p.10, https://www.manualslib.com/manual/3184167/Siemens-Sinamics-Connect-500.html?page=10)
Spec specs/01.md (acceptance criteria) and specs/00-common.md section 0.5
tolerance: exact for every check: all quantities are integer route counts or categorical/boolean outcomes of a discrete graph model; there is no numerical approximation, so any deviation is a logic difference.

not_benchmarked.Required counts: isolation_points_required / residual_energy_actions required counts: their counting convention (per device, per route, per store) is not fixed by the spec or any source read
not_benchmarked.Output format and UI: exact finding and register wording, CSV/JSON/PDF layout, permalink, 7-language UI, keyboard/mobile acceptance criteria (UI, not model)
not_benchmarked.Ambiguous method pairings: rotating mass dissipated by waiting, spring released, thermal and plug/coupling isolation of fluid lines: the valid method pairings are ambiguous and not fixed by a source read
not_benchmarked.Series work zones: series work zones (README: search stops at the first work zone) — a tool convention with no independent basis
not_benchmarked.Out of MVP scope: reaccumulation (29 CFR 1910.147(d)(5)(ii)), group lockout, dependency of 'independent' barriers, double block and bleed — out of MVP scope per README
not_benchmarked.Exchange contracts: safety-exchange handoff contracts (not a safety claim)

self_tests.note: 86 of 86 window.__safetyTests() entries pass in this build.

adapter.note: Reference objects map one-to-one onto tool kinds; roles "authorized employee"/"electrician" map to assigned roles; the reference has no intervention type, so the tool default (mechanical repair) is used.

disputed.note: el-verified-by-try-start was disputed by the builder; the manager upheld the reference and the tool now refuses try-start where an electrical line enters the work zone (LOTO-R-020).
